title: Power combos in the Draft helper
text: Some pairs, like Auriel + Cho'gall, are much stronger together than apart. When one half is picked, the Draft helper now suggests the other with a gold Power combo line, and Best bans warns you when the enemy can finish one. Cho'gall is also one hero now for picks and bans.

title: Power combos on the match banner
text: When a team has both heroes of a power combo, the banner shows the tier they play at together with a gold link mark, and the draft edge counts it.

title: Easier to read win/loss dots
text: The win/loss dots next to the score are now all full circles, so losses are easy to see on stream too. Losing streaks show as solid blue dots.

title: Builds button on the tier list
text: Click a hero on the tier list and the info box now has a button that takes you straight to that hero's builds. Cho'gall gets one for Cho and one for Gall.

title: New numbers on the home page
text: The numbers under the intro now show heroes, total builds, when the tier list was last updated and the current patch. Click any of them to jump to that page.

title: Clearer level labels on builds
text: Builds now label levels as LV 1, LV 4 and so on, with the level number brighter, so they no longer read like Lv 11.

title: Hero changes from every patch
text: The Patch notes page now shows a short summary of every hero change with talent icons and green buff / red nerf arrows, with filters for buffs, nerfs, role and hero. Each hero's builds page shows what the last patch changed (and every patch before), and builds that take a changed talent say so. In chat, !patch tells you what the latest patch changed.

title: Patch notes page
text: A new Patch notes tab lists every official Heroes of the Storm patch, newest first, with the heroes each patch changed (tap one for its builds) and a link to Blizzard's full notes. It updates by itself.

title: Talent, ability and hero icons in build notes
text: Build notes now show little icons when they mention a talent, an ability or a hero (nicknames like KT and ETC work too). Hover a hero to see their tier and win rate. Notes can also show talents of other heroes the build is about.

title: Recommended builds
text: My favourite build for a hero gets a coral Recommended badge and shows first.

title: Overlay size slider
text: The talent overlay can now be resized. The default lines it up with the game's own HUD.

title: New overlay look
text: The talent panel got a cleaner look: no dark box, a soft fade instead, the rank badge on the side of your choice, win rate on the panel, and a header that lights up on a win streak.

title: !rank chat command
text: Viewers can type !rank (or just ask "what rank?") and the bot replies with my current rank, including the Master or Grandmaster number.

title: Tier list popup in the website look
text: The !tierlist popup on stream and the tier list editor now use the same look as junhots.com.

title: More reliable win/loss tracking
text: Every match result now counts, a manual win or loss always counts, and a result entered twice by mistake is ignored. A wrong result can be undone.

title: Live tier list on the home page
text: The Tier list card on the home page now shows the real, current tier list, with heroes that moved this week.

title: Hero search in match history
text: The match history page shows heroes in two rows and has a search box to find games on a hero.

title: Older games in match history
text: My older ranked games were imported from replays, so match history now goes back much further (up to 5000 games, no duplicates).

title: Hero style tags
text: Heroes now have style tags like Dive, Poke and Sustain, with an icon each. You see them on build pages, the tier list, search and in the Draft helper's reasons.

title: New match-start banner
text: The banner at the start of a match now sits under the game's own top bar, with each hero's tier in a slanted tab and the draft edge under the score. It uses the same draft math as the website's Draft helper.

title: Cho'gall ranked as one hero
text: Cho and Gall now share one Cho'gall spot on every tier list. Their builds and games stay separate.

title: Match history and game cards
text: Click a recent game to see K/D/A, the talent build (load it in one click), both teams, bans and the draft edge. A full Match history page has filters and a summary.

title: Draft helper and my recent games
text: New Draft page: pick heroes and bans for both teams and a map to see who has the edge and the best bans. The home page also shows my last 10 ranked games, sent by the overlay after every match. The tier list shows when it was last updated and which heroes moved this week.

title: New map picker
text: Maps on the Tier list and Draft pages have their own icon and color, and open as a grid that shows each map's objective.

title: Smoother site
text: Pages fade into each other, the coral line under the tabs slides to the new page, and pages start loading when you hover a link.

title: Latest video and live status on the home page
text: The Twitch button says when I'm live and the YouTube button flags a new video. Hover them for a quick peek. The search button cycles through hero names.

title: Better build notes
text: Build notes can have line breaks and notes for specific levels ("Lvl 13: ..."), marked with a dot on the talent. Builds can list heroes to take them against ("Take it vs") and with ("Take it with"). Each hero page shows good and bad matchups from the tier list.

title: Home page cards
text: The fan of hero cards on the home page glides smoothly, the Builds card shows the 3 best S-tier heroes, and the Make your own card has buttons for both makers.

title: New coral look
text: The whole site got a new coral theme, a new home page with a fan of S-tier heroes, hero art on the Builds page, quick search (Ctrl+K) and link previews when you share a page.

title: Tier list syncs to the website
text: When I save my tier list in the overlay, junhots.com updates by itself.

title: Build page upgrades
text: Hover talents and abilities to read them, click a build to see it on the talent grid, save your own builds in your browser, and a new Make your own menu in the top bar.

title: Empty tier list maker
text: The tier list maker now starts empty for new visitors, with a Reset button.

title: !builds chat command
text: Type !builds in chat to get a link to every hero's builds on junhots.com.

title: Banner and editor upgrades
text: The match banner puts heroes on the same side as in game, and the tier list editor got hero search, synergy and full square portraits.

title: Situational talents
text: Builds can mark situational talents for each level, shown with an amber corner.

title: Builds for every hero
text: New Builds page with talents and abilities for every hero, my builds with a Copy build code button for the game, and your own builds you can share with a link.

title: junhots.com is live
text: The website launched with my tier list (counters, synergy and win rates), a tier list maker and a page about the stream overlay.

title: Tier list on stream
text: Viewers can type !tierlist to pop my tier list up on stream. When a match starts, a banner shows both teams with tiers, counters, win rates and who has the edge. Chat messages are editable, with Log in with Twitch.

title: Updated to patch 2.57
text: Talents and icons refreshed for patch 2.57.0, with an easy update tool for future patches.

title: Every hero detected
text: The overlay now recognises every hero automatically, including tricky ones like Lt. Morales and Medivh.

title: Rank, streak and win/loss banner
text: The overlay shows a big rank emblem, a win/loss banner after each game, a header colored by the win streak, and rank-up animations.

title: Overlay restyle and talent animations
text: A new look for the talent panel with adjustable panel darkness, a flash when a talent is picked (special effects at levels 10 and 20) and hotkeys that keep working all stream.
